subject: [PATCH 6/9] mm/gup: return a huge page's full count from follow_page_mask()

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch modifies the follow_page_mask() function in the mm/gup module to return the full count of huge pages instead of reporting it via a separate page_mask output. The changes also remove unnecessary code and improve error handling for try_grab_folio(). The patch affects the follow_huge_pud() and follow_huge_pmd() functions, which now report their count as the return value. Additionally, the -EEXIST path is updated to handle pages == NULL correctly.
